BiblicalUsage: This, the little Aramaic pointer word that Daniel uses again and again to point at the dream and the vision. Nebuchadnezzar saw this great image, and Daniel points to this horn that made war with the saints. It does the plain work of saying which thing is meant.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's revelation is specific, not vague. Daniel does not gesture at some general idea; he points at this image, this horn, this kingdom, and I believe God speaks that plainly still.
